concerns.text: Task T034a instructs to 'iterate over depths starting at a substantial initial value, incrementing by a fixed step size' but fails to define the specific start value, step size, or the set of depths. Spec FR-005 mandates the set {5,000, ..., min_depth}. Without explicit values, an implementer cannot deterministically execute this task.

Task T037 requires comparing R² against a 'high percentile' threshold. Spec SC-003 and US-3 Independent Test explicitly require the '95th percentile'. The task does not specify '95th', making the success criterion untestable and the execution ambiguous.
